# Security

## Reporting a weakness

Do not open a public issue, and do not put details in a pull request.

- **Bearclave staff and contractors:** open an issue of the type `Security`
  in this repository; it is private to the organisation.
- **Anyone else:** e-mail <info@bearclave.cz>
  with what you found, where, and how to reproduce it.

You get an answer within five working days. A weakness with real exposure is
fixed before other work.

## Scope

The code in this repository and what its pipeline deploys. Customer tenants
are reported to the customer.

Rules: [bearclave/governance standards/security.md](https://github.com/bearclave/governance/blob/main/standards/security.md).
